Package cr.ac.una.parking.coto.model

Class Vehicle

java.lang.Object
cr.ac.una.parking.coto.model.Vehicle
Direct Known Subclasses:
Car, FreightVehicle, Motorcycle
public abstract class Vehicle extends Object
Represents the common abstraction for every vehicle admitted by the parking system.

All vehicles share the same core information: plate, brand, model, color, and category. Concrete subclasses specialize their behavior by redefining the required parking space type and the fee calculation, which is the main mechanism used to apply polymorphism in the project.

The design avoids external type checks such as instanceof or chained conditionals to decide pricing. Instead, the system delegates the calculation to the concrete object that is actually being used.

Version:
1.0
Author:
Carolain Quesada and Ashly Delgado
